verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs describe API parameters for Document AI in detail (table_format, extract_header/extract_footer, include_blocks, confidence_scores_granularity, bbox/document annotations, document_url/image_url inputs). There are official Python and TypeScript SDKs and a /v1/batch endpoint, and a community user confirms driving OCR successfully through the API. Agent-friendly llms.txt and markdown docs are also available. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), explicit OCR endpoint reference documentation in the pack, and documented handling of large documents (a hands-on user hit timeouts on 900 pages and had to chunk them).
